item.title: 9/11 remembrance meets meme generation's dark humor
item.description: America says "never forget," but a growing share of Americans don't remember. More are coming of age with no firsthand memory of the events.

item.title: RNC's Legal Battles Over Election Integrity
item.description: With the midterms less than two months away, Republicans are engaged in roughly 200 legal fights aimed at influencing elections, including several cases in key states.

item.title: AI's Growing Role in Biological Research Risks
item.description: Recent stark warnings about unregulated artificial intelligence wiping out humanity are drawing fresh attention to how these models are already being applied in biological research.

item.title: The Next Phase of the AI Safety Debate
item.description: A week of striking AI warnings is moving the Washington debate from whether to regulate toward how far lawmakers will actually go.
